contract.task_clause:
The genetic fallacy consists of
Option A: arguing that a conclusion should be made based on feeling sorry for someone when that feeling is irrelevant to the conclusion
Option B: responding to charges of wrongdoing by saying the accuser does something just as bad
Option C: arguing that an idea should be accepted or rejected based only on who originated the idea.
Option D: causing confusion during refutation because of a real or feigned lack of ability to engage in refutation
